title: Unidentified hyperobjects

tellings.quote:
>> There's a really cool professor named
James Madden who wrote a book called
unidentified
hyper objects.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells his listeners about a professor named James Madden, who he says wrote a book called Unidentified Hyperobjects. Michels calls him "a really cool professor" and brings up the book as a way to think about UFOs as something bigger and stranger than ordinary objects in the sky.
